main_text.p: BERII & fupra Catonum gravitatem afcendentia, fuperftites P. SYRI fen-tentiæ docebunt, Dictaturam Ro-manos inter vates communi gentium: fuffragio nactus VIRGILIUS. MA-RO, paftoritia ECLOGARUM de-cade jucunditati magis quàm ufui, con-dimento eruditionis, quàm emolu-mento, nifi per violentas allegorias ex-torquendo, confulit. Delectatione: inferior GEORGICORUM tetras, rufticæ vitæ folatia, miro, diligentis in-geniiin afpera materia cultu, lententia-rum emblematis infertis, expromit: Magno fed non ad incudem revocato, ÆNEIDOS operel, togatam & arma-tam Principis virtutem, ficta ad um-bram veritatis Ænea in adverfis con-tantia, infecundis moderatione, ex-tollit.
